[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 25
- Description: Accountant call — Black King SIMPLES tax, new CNPJ handover, R$674.37 payment
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  Time spent speaking with the accountant (Jussileide — Black King Contabilidade, via the Black King WhatsApp group) and Saymon (Nota Fiscal / invoicing), covering corporate structure, Brazilian tax obligations, and settling the outstanding SIMPLES liability.
  
  SUBSTANTIVE MATTERS HANDLED (all evidenced in the attached 4-page PDF):
  
  1. CORPORATE STRUCTURE CHANGE — the lawyers are in the process of opening a new CNPJ. Once it is issued, the plan is for the accountant's firm to service that new entity instead of Black King, and Black King becomes inactive. This is a structural handover that affects who invoices, who files, and which entity carries the tax exposure going forward — not a routine admin change.
  
  2. SIMPLES TAX GUIDE (guia) — the accountant explained the SIMPLES guide: it is the tax charged on invoiced revenue (faturamento). In October, Black King issued a sales invoice for goods; the guide covers the tax on October sales. The assessment period is the full calendar month (01-31 October) and payment falls due 23 November. Confirmed the obligation and the deadline.
  
  3. PAYMENT SETTLED — R$674.37 BRL paid via Wise to Wise Brasil Corretora de Cambio Ltda on 17/11/2026 at 19:58, funded from USD 118.70 with USD 2.00 in Wise fees at a guaranteed rate of 1 USD = 5.7786 BRL. This clears the SIMPLES liability ahead of the 23 November due date.
  
  WHY THIS WAS WORTH RECORDING: the conversation resolved both an immediate compliance obligation (a dated tax payment that would otherwise accrue penalties) and a forward-looking structural question (which entity the accountant serves after the new CNPJ issues). The second point has downstream implications for how the Brazilian operations are invoiced and accounted for.
  
  TIME BASIS: 25 minutes, as directed by the governor. TDG derived by the dao_client rubric SSOT (rubric.py: Time (Minutes) = minutes / 60 * 100 = 25 / 60 * 100 = 41.67), not supplied by hand.
  
  ATTACHMENTS:
  - accountant_evidence_2026-11-17.pdf (attached to this submission) — 4 pages, each carrying one source screenshot with an explanatory caption: (p1) WhatsApp thread with Jussileide and Saymon, new CNPJ notice; (p2) accountant's written explanation of the SIMPLES guia and the 23 Nov deadline; (p3) Wise transfer breakdown R$674.37 / USD 118.70 / fee USD 2.00 / rate 5.7786; (p4) Pix receipt for R$674.37 to Wise Brasil, 17/11/2026 19:58.
  - Evidence also mirrored in the context repo: contributions/evidence/2026-11-17_accountant_evidence.pdf
  
  NOTE ON PR FIELD: this work is operational (an accountant conversation), not code, so there is no code PR of its own. The two PR URLs cited are from the same working thread, where the PDF generation SOP and its indexing were authored and merged — included only because the reporting tool requires at least one PR URL and will not accept a non-pull GitHub link.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 41.67
- Attached Filename: accountant_evidence_2026-11-17.pdf
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/accountant_evidence_2026-11-17.pdf
